claims.statement: Conditional on the declared per-invocation engineering budgets, one prepared job crosses the real asynchronous queue and is delivered with probability at least 0.98.
assumptions: The 0.01 queue-admission and 0.01 queue-take bad-event limits are engineering envelope assumptions, not statistical estimates.
The p=1 standard-library boundary assumptions mean an unexpected exception or wrong return type is a retained Dagcert violation rather than a silent success.
